glowthreadlink:
{{doc-special|GlowThreadLink|unlisted=1}}
Permalink to a comment. Redirects to the comment on its page. [[Special:FlowThreadLink]] is an alias of it.
flowthreadmanage:
{{doc-special|FlowThreadManage|unlisted=1}}
Old FlowThread moderation page, now a redirect to the moderation queue.
glowthread-special-nojs: Shown on [[Special:GlowThread]] until the JavaScript app loads, and to readers without JavaScript.
glowthread-link-notfound: Shown on [[Special:GlowThreadLink]] when the comment does not exist or the reader cannot see it.
glowthread-nojs: Shown in a noscript element at the end of the content of pages with comments, to readers without JavaScript.
glowthread-filter: Default content of the word filter page [[MediaWiki:GlowThread-filter]]. Every line starts with #, so there are no rules by default. Keep the # at the start of each line. Keep the quoted examples (spam, cheap coins and the texts they match) in English: they show how rules in scripts with spaces between words match.
log-name-glowthread:
{{doc-logpage}}
Name of the comment log, where GlowThread records moderation actions, page comment settings and settings changes.
log-name-glowthread-private:
{{doc-logpage}}
Name of the restricted log recording authors of erased comments.
log-description-glowthread-private: Description of the restricted comment erasure log.
log-name-comments:
{{doc-logpage}}
Name of the log of FlowThread, the comment extension a wiki used before GlowThread (log type comments). Registered only on wikis that turn on $wgGlowThreadLegacyCompat.
log-description-comments: Description of FlowThread's old comment log.
logentry-comments-erase:
{{Logentry}}
Log entry written by FlowThread.
* $4 - name of the comment author
* $5 - number of replies erased with it
glowthread-logentry-private-erase:
{{Logentry}}
Restricted entry with the author.
* $4 - link to the comment
* $5 - link to the comment author
glowthread-logentry-approve:
{{Logentry}}
A held comment was approved.
* $4 - link to the comment
* $5 - link to the comment author
glowthread-logentry-markchecked:
{{Logentry}}
Open reports were dismissed.
* $4 - link to the comment
* $5 - link to the comment author
glowthread-logentry-autohold:
{{Logentry}}
A visible comment was held for review automatically because enough users reported it. The performer ($1) is the system user GlowThread.
* $4 - link to the comment
* $5 - link to the comment author
glowthread-logentry-undo:
{{Logentry}}
* $4 - link to the comment
* $5 - link to the comment author
* $7 - ID of the log entry whose action was undone
glowthread-logentry-enable:
{{Logentry}}
Comments on the page were set to open.
glowthread-logentry-lock:
{{Logentry}}
Comments on the page were locked: readable, no new comments.
glowthread-logentry-disable:
{{Logentry}}
Comments on the page were turned off.
glowthread-logentry-settings:
{{Logentry}}
* $4 - comma-separated list of changes, each formatted with {{msg-mw|glowthread-log-setting-change}}
glowthread-log-comment:
{{optional}}
Link text for a comment in log entries.
* $1 - floor number of the comment on its page
* $2 - comment ID
glowthread-log-author-hidden: Shown instead of the author name in log entries about comments that were later erased.
glowthread-log-setting-change:
{{optional}}
One setting change in a settings log entry.
* $1 - setting name
* $2 - old value
* $3 - new value
glowthread-log-undelete-state: Reason saved, in the wiki's content language, with the {{msg-mw|glowthread-logentry-lock}} or {{msg-mw|glowthread-logentry-disable}} log entry written when an undeletion merges the revisions of an earlier, deleted page into a page re-created at its title. The page then keeps the stricter comment setting of the two, so comments hidden on the earlier page stay hidden.
glowthread-error-page-missing: API error: the page does not exist.
glowthread-error-page-ineligible: API error: comments are not available in this namespace or on this page.
glowthread-error-disabled: API error: comments are turned off on the page.
glowthread-error-locked: API error: the page's comments are locked.
glowthread-error-too-long:
API error.
* $1 - maximum length in characters
glowthread-error-too-many-mentions:
API error.
* $1 - maximum number of mentioned users
glowthread-error-duplicate: API error: the same text was posted on the same page within the duplicate window.
glowthread-error-too-many-held:
API error (code toomanyheld): the author already has the maximum number of comments waiting for review, and the new comment would be held too.
* $1 - maximum number of comments waiting for review ($wgGlowThreadMaxHeldPerUser)
glowthread-error-undo-logids: API error (code badlogids): do=undo was sent without logids, or with a different number of logids than ids.
glowthread-error-parent: API error: the comment being replied to is missing, hidden or on another page.
glowthread-error-comment-missing: API error: the comment does not exist or is not visible.
glowthread-error-new-account-like: API error (code newaccount): the account would be held by the new-account gate ($wgGlowThreadNewAccountHours, $wgGlowThreadNewAccountApproved), so it cannot like comments yet. Removing a like is still allowed.
glowthread-error-report-reason: API error: the report reason is turned off.
glowthread-error-note-too-long:
API error.
* $1 - maximum length in characters
glowthread-error-not-author: API error: someone other than the author tried to self-delete a comment.
glowthread-error-bad-status:
API error.
* $1 - moderation action
* $2 - current status of the comment (visible, held, deleted, erased)
glowthread-error-setting-range:
API error.
* $1 - setting name
* $2 - minimum
* $3 - maximum
glowthread-error-setting-range-off:
API error, for a setting that also takes a value meaning off.
* $1 - setting name
* $2 - minimum
* $3 - maximum
* $4 - the value that turns it off (0)
glowthread-error-settings-json: API error: the settings parameter is not a JSON object.
echo-category-title-glowthread:
{{Related|Echo-category-title}}
Title of the notification category for comments, in [[Special:Preferences#mw-prefsection-echo]].
echo-pref-tooltip-glowthread:
{{Related|Echo-pref-tooltip}}
Tooltip of the comments notification category in the preferences.
notification-header-glowthread-reply:
{{Related|Notification-header}}
Header of the notification sent to the author of a comment that got a reply.
* $1 - name of the person who replied, or a placeholder when it is hidden
* $2 - name of that person, for GENDER
* $3 - page title
* $4 - name of the user who reads the notification, for GENDER
notification-compact-header-glowthread-r:
{{Related|Notification-compact-header}}
One reply inside a bundle of replies.
* $1 - name of the person who replied
* $2 - name of that person, for GENDER
* $3 - name of the user who reads the notification, for GENDER
notification-bundle-header-glowthread-re:
{{Related|Notification-bundle-header}}
Several unread replies on one page, shown as one notification.
* $1 - number of replies
* $2 - page title
* $3 - name of the user who reads the notification, for GENDER
notification-bundle-header-glowthread-me:
{{Related|Notification-bundle-header}}
Several unread mentions on one page, shown as one notification.
* $1 - number of mentions
* $2 - page title
* $3 - name of the user who reads the notification, for GENDER
notification-header-glowthread-mention:
{{Related|Notification-header}}
Header of the notification sent to a user mentioned (@name) in a comment.
* $1 - name of the comment author, or a placeholder when it is hidden
* $2 - name of the author, for GENDER
* $3 - page title
* $4 - name of the user who reads the notification, for GENDER
notification-compact-header-glowthread-m:
{{Related|Notification-compact-header}}
* $1 - name of the comment author
* $2 - name of the author, for GENDER
* $3 - name of the user who reads the notification, for GENDER
notification-header-glowthread-userpage:
{{Related|Notification-header}}
Header of the notification sent to a user when someone comments on their user page (not on its subpages).
* $1 - name of the comment author, or a placeholder when it is hidden
* $2 - name of the author, for GENDER
* $3 - page title (unused)
* $4 - name of the user who reads the notification, for GENDER
notification-compact-header-glowthread-u:
{{Related|Notification-compact-header}}
* $1 - name of the comment author
* $2 - name of the author, for GENDER
* $3 - name of the user who reads the notification, for GENDER
notification-header-glowthread-moderatio:
{{Related|Notification-header}}
A moderator deleted the reader's comment. The moderator is not named.
* $1 - page title
* $2 - name of the user who reads the notification, for GENDER

{{Related|Notification-header}}
A moderator restored the reader's deleted comment.
* $1 - page title
* $2 - name of the user who reads the notification, for GENDER

{{Related|Notification-header}}
A moderator approved the reader's comment, which was waiting for review.
* $1 - page title
* $2 - name of the user who reads the notification, for GENDER
notification-body-glowthread-unavailable: Body of comment notifications when the comment was deleted, is waiting for review or was erased since, so its text is no longer shown.
notification-body-glowthread-moderation-:
Body of the deletion notification when the moderator gave a reason.
* $1 - the reason, as plain text
notification-link-text-view-glowthread-c: Label of the link from a notification to the comment.
notification-link-text-view-glowthread-p: Label of the link from a notification to the page, when the comment is no longer visible.
echo-category-title-flowthread:
{{Related|Echo-category-title}}
Category of notifications sent by FlowThread, the comment system GlowThread replaced. Not offered in the preferences.
echo-pref-tooltip-flowthread:
{{Related|Echo-pref-tooltip}}
Tooltip of the FlowThread notification category.
notification-header-flowthread_reply:
{{Related|Notification-header}}
Notification stored by FlowThread: someone replied to the reader's comment.
* $1 - name of the person who replied
* $2 - name of that person, for GENDER
* $3 - page title
* $4 - name of the user who reads the notification, for GENDER
notification-header-flowthread_userpage:
{{Related|Notification-header}}
Notification stored by FlowThread: someone commented on the reader's user page.
* $1 - name of the comment author
* $2 - name of the author, for GENDER
* $3 - page title (unused)
* $4 - name of the user who reads the notification, for GENDER
notification-header-flowthread_mention:
{{Related|Notification-header}}
Notification stored by FlowThread: the reader was mentioned in a comment.
* $1 - name of the comment author
* $2 - name of the author, for GENDER
* $3 - page title
* $4 - name of the user who reads the notification, for GENDER
notification-header-flowthread_delete:
{{Related|Notification-header}}
Notification stored by FlowThread: the reader's comment was deleted.
* $1, $2 - unused
* $3 - page title
* $4 - name of the user who reads the notification, for GENDER
notification-header-flowthread_recover:
{{Related|Notification-header}}
Notification stored by FlowThread: the reader's comment was restored.
* $1, $2 - unused
* $3 - page title
* $4 - name of the user who reads the notification, for GENDER
notification-header-flowthread_spam:
{{Related|Notification-header}}
Notification stored by FlowThread: the reader's comment was caught by the spam filter.
* $1, $2 - unused
* $3 - page title
* $4 - name of the user who reads the notification, for GENDER
